# Granth Agrawal

> Freelance graphic designer and video editor creating premium visuals, motion graphics, and post-production for brands, creators, and startups.

Granth Agrawal is an independent designer based in India offering graphic design, video editing, motion graphics, and brand visual systems. Clients reach out via WhatsApp or email for project inquiries.
